  

Your first steps as a Trainer, one page at a time.

The README book next to this one has every control.

 §4§l1. Your Starter§r

The Starter screen opens when you first join. Pick a region, then your partner.

If you close it, sneak twice to open it again.

 §4§l2. Your Party§r

Up to six Pokemon travel with you in their balls, shown down the left of your screen.

Use the Party item to send out the selected one. Sneak and use it to pick another.

 §4§l3. First Battle§r

Look at a wild Pokemon and use the Party item.

Winning earns experience. Pokemon level up, learn new moves and can evolve.

 §4§l4. Poke Balls§r

Craft 4  Poke Balls from 4 Red Apricorns around a Copper Ingot.

Apricorns grow on apricorn trees in the wild.

 §4§l5. Catching§r

Weaken a wild Pokemon, choose Catch, and throw a ball at it.

The ball shakes up to three times. If it stays shut, the Pokemon is yours.

 §4§l6. Healing§r

A fainted Pokemon wakes after 5 minutes with a little health. A bed heals half.

A Healing Machine heals fully. Craft one from copper, iron, redstone and a Max Revive.

 §4§l7. Storage§r

Only six travel with you. A PC keeps the rest. Craft one from iron, glass, copper and smooth stone.

A Pasture lets them roam at home.

 §4§l8. Pokedex§r

Craft a Pokedex from an apricorn, copper, iron and glowstone or redstone.

Scan Pokemon to learn about them and fill your register.
